scientific_integrity: Exact weighted-enumeration proof, majorization transfer identity, sharp extremal equalities, and independent Prüfer-code enumerative cross-check. No outside verification or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires positive assigned degrees and a uniform labeled tree conditioned on the entire degree vector; not a theorem for unordered degree multisets or other tree models. Full texts of some early historical comparators were unavailable. Finite checks are not substitutes for proof.
title: Sharp degree-majorization bounds for distances between marked vertices in random labeled trees
